metadata.title: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach for Ramp Metering Based on Traffic Video Data
supplementary_materials: data available from the corresponding author upon request

hyperparameters.name: State matrix dimension
hyperparameters.context: Input size for the Q-network representing three consecutive frames of traffic video.

hyperparameters.name: Replay buffer size B
hyperparameters.context: Capacity of the experience replay buffer for stabilizing training.

hyperparameters.name: Training steps T
hyperparameters.context: Number of decision time steps in one training episode.

hyperparameters.name: Learning rate Η
hyperparameters.context: Step size for the Adam optimizer during weight updates.

hyperparameters.name: Batch size k
hyperparameters.context: Number of transitions sampled from the replay buffer for each gradient update.

hyperparameters.name: Exploration rate Ε
hyperparameters.context: Probability of taking a random action in the Ε-greedy strategy.

hyperparameters.name: Freeze interval F
hyperparameters.context: Frequency of updating the target network parameters by copying the Q-network weights.

hyperparameters.name: Decision step size L
hyperparameters.context: Fixed time interval between ramp metering control actions.

metadata.hardware_requirements: computing server with NVIDIA Quadro K620 GPU and Intel Xeon CPU E5-1650 (3.6 GHz, 6 cores)

nodes_source.source_quote: A series of simulation experiments based on real-world traffic data are conducted to evaluate the proposed approach.
nodes_source.description: Traffic volumes and driving behavior parameters from the freeway connecting Qingdao and Huangdao, used to calibrate the SUMO simulator for the case study evaluation.
nodes_source.size_estimate: 10-min traffic volumes from 7:50 a.m. to 9:00 a.m.
nodes_source.reproducibility_rationale: The Data Availability section states that the data used to support the results are available from the corresponding author upon request.

nodes_process.source_quote: Vehicle locations are extracted from the traffic video frames and are reformed as position matrices.
nodes_process.description: Extracts vehicle coordinates (xi, yi) from raw video frames and maps them to position matrices mt where cells containing vehicles are set to a constant UV and signal states to UG or UR.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=3, extraction tool not named, observation size stated

nodes_process.source_quote: we stack the matrices of consecutive N time steps to represent the state st
nodes_process.description: Stacks N consecutive position matrices after down-sampling to capture vehicle dynamics and signal phase history into a single high-dimensional state tensor.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, generic tools used without library names, dimensions stated

nodes_process.source_quote: The algorithm for training the ramp metering policy is presented in Algorithm 1.
nodes_process.description: Trains a CNN-based Q-network using multitask learning to predict Q-values, mean speed, and queue length. Employs experience replay and a frozen target network for stability.
nodes_process.reproducibility_rationale: clarity=4, 1/6 tools named, all 8 hyperparameters stated

nodes_process.source_quote: The proposed method is evaluated in SUMO, an open-source microscopic traffic simulator
nodes_process.description: Evaluates the trained model in a real-world freeway merge scenario (Qingdao-Huangdao tunnel) against PI-ALINEA and no-control baselines using travel time and queue metrics.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 8: Convergence curves for (a) episode reward and (b) mean travel time.
nodes_sink.description: Training convergence curves showing the episode reward and mean travel time over 1 million frames.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Training process and parameters are well-defined, but the exact real-world dataset version is not provided via URL.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 9: Vehicle travel times in the mainline.
nodes_sink.description: Comparison of mainline vehicle travel times (min) over time for No control, PI-ALINEA, and Deep RL scenarios.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Simulation setup in SUMO is clearly described and parameters provided; dataset is described but lacks a direct link.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Table 2: Mean travel times in 20 simulation experiments (s).
nodes_sink.description: Mean vehicle travel times (seconds) across 20 simulation runs for No controls, PI-ALINEA, and DRL, including percentage improvements.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Results follow directly from the described simulation of the real-world case study.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 10: Temporal-spatial distribution of speed in (a) no-control; (b) PI-ALINEA; (c) DRL.
nodes_sink.description: Heatmaps showing speed distribution across distance and time for three control scenarios.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Visualization of simulation outcomes is consistent with reported metrics; upstream data is described but not linked.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 11: Queue length at the on-ramp.
nodes_sink.description: Temporal distribution of vehicle queue lengths at the on-ramp for the three scenarios.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Direct output of the simulation experiments using stated parameters.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 12: Relationship of queue length and red ratio for (a) PI-ALINEA and (b) DRL.
nodes_sink.description: Scatter plots showing the correlation between red signal ratio and resulting queue length.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Derived from simulation logs; methodology for calculation is clear.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 13: Queue length and occupancy for (a) PI-ALINEA and (b) DRL.
nodes_sink.description: Time-series comparison of occupancy percentage and queue length for two control methods.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Standard simulation outputs; correlation coefficients provided.

nodes_sink.source_quote: Figure 14: Downstream volume in three scenarios.
nodes_sink.description: Box plots showing the distribution of downstream traffic volume (veh/h) over time for three scenarios.
nodes_sink.reproducibility_rationale: Aggregated simulation data; consistent with other reported findings.
